identitySignals: Agenda names the Regents of the University of California acting for the Public Service Center's College Corps Program at the Berkeley campus. The UC Berkeley Public Service Center website has a College Corps program page.
Location matches the agenda: the Public Service Center is at UC Berkeley in Berkeley, CA.
The College Corps page says fellows serve with community partners on K-12 education and other issues. This fits OUSD's Community Schools and Student Services partnership agreement.
The Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Clearinghouse lists UC Berkeley as a campus of the Regents of the University of California.
research.notes: The vendor is the Regents of the University of California, acting for a UC Berkeley campus program. Contact details are for the Public Service Center, not the whole UC system. I left the registry IDs null on purpose. The EIN differs between UC campuses and the system office, and the SAM UEI and any California entity number could not be tied to this campus unit from the pages I read. The Regents is a constitutional public corporation, so a California Secretary of State business entity number may not exist. The website is the Public Service Center's site, which I took from the cited College Corps page's URL. I did not fetch its homepage.

profile.legalName: The Regents of the University of California
profile.summary: The Regents of the University of California is the governing body of the University of California public university system. The UC Berkeley Public Service Center runs service and community-engagement programs for students. One is College Corps, an AmeriCorps program run with California Volunteers, where undergraduates serve with community partners.

sources.title: University of California, Berkeley - FDP Clearinghouse

review.notes: The College Corps page describes a UC Berkeley Public Service Center AmeriCorps program run with California Volunteers, in which undergraduates serve community partners, including in K-12 education. The page also lists the same phone, email and Bancroft Way mailing address, and the FDP Clearinghouse gives the legal name as Regents of the University of California, doing business as UC Berkeley, a public institution. The summary's line that the Regents governs the UC system is general background rather than an exact source quote, but it is accurate and neutral, and the contact details are for the office, not a named person.
